notes: Ibn Abbas, Abd al-Rahman ibn Azhar and al-Miswar are the senders of Kurayb («أرسلوه إلى عائشة»): scene, not links
Aisha only sends Kurayb on to Umm Salama, who gives the Prophet's words, so Umm Salama is the last link (rule 6)

fixes.reason: K6I lists Ibn Abbas and Abd al-Rahman as transmitters in the chain; the text names them only as the men who sent Kurayb on the errand.

evidence.quote: أن عبد الله بن عباس، وعبد الرحمن بن أزهر، والمسور بن مخرمة، أرسلوه إلى عائشة
عبد الله بن العباس بن عبد المطلب  الحبر  رضي الله عنه
